propositions: REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE environment variable must point to a TOML file whose keys layer over discovered config rather than replace it entirely
per-key precedence order is: CLI -c > REBAR_LLM_<KEY> env > REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE > discovered config > default
deep merge must apply recursively to nested tables while arrays replace wholesale rather than append
env var name must be read as a string literal os.environ.get("REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE") to enable static AST scanning by gen_env_registry.py and avoid doc-gate failures
missing file pointed to by REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE must fail loudly with a typed rebar config error rather than silently fall back
read_reserved_section shallow-merge behavior must remain unchanged for non-llm reserved sections to prevent unintended scope creep
